title: CI/CD & Release Engineering: Cloud Deploy — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Canary Progressive Promotion Flow: Phase 1 (10% traffic for 15 min) -> Phase 2 (50% traffic for 30 min) -> Phase 3 (100% full promotion).
routing_rationale: Progressive phase advancements require automated metric verification across each stage, guaranteeing system stability before traffic ramps up.

nodes.label: Canary Stage 1 (10%)
nodes.detail: Monitors error rate and p99 latency against baseline.

nodes.label: Automated Metric Gate
nodes.detail: Cloud Monitoring MQL confirms zero SLO regression during Phase 1.

nodes.label: Canary Stage 2 (50%)
nodes.detail: Increases traffic to 50% to test database connection pool under higher concurrency.

nodes.label: Full Promotion (100%)
nodes.detail: Retires v1.0 baseline pods; v1.1 handles 100% of production traffic.

steps.title: Stage 1 Metric Verification
steps.action: Cloud Deploy checks Cloud Monitoring metrics; automatically promotes to 50% traffic.
steps.why_traversal: Automates release verification without requiring engineers to stare at dashboards.

steps.title: Full Production Cutover
steps.action: After 30 minutes at 50% load, full rollout executes; old pods drained cleanly.
steps.why_traversal: Completes zero-downtime progressive deployment with complete confidence.

scenarios.label: Phase 2 Concurrency Exhausts DB Connections
scenarios.root_cause: At 50% traffic, database connection pool hit hard limit of 200 connections.
scenarios.diverted_path: Latency spiked; Cloud Deploy halted Phase 2 and initiated automatic rollback.
scenarios.recovery: Deploy PgBouncer / Cloud SQL Proxy connection pooling before re-attempting rollout.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Traces Canary Progressive Promotion Flow: Phase 1 (10% traffic for 15 min) -> Phase 2 (50% traffic for 30 min) -> Phase 3 (100% full promotion).
